So:

Project number: R3-0033 appears on page 1. That might be a PTB project/reference number. The schema has project_number in certificate. I'll put "R3-0033".

Models: Q200 Q3=2.5 (3 variants with Q3/Q1 = 160, 200, 250), SM250 (E,P) (2 variants: Q3/Q1 = 200, 160), SM700 (E,P) (2 variants: Q3/Q1 = 200, 160).
